svg.title: AI Model Supply Chain & Deserialization Safety Architecture
svg.desc: AI Model Supply Chain diagram comparing PyTorch pickle RCE risks with Safetensors byte buffers, ModelScan CLI, and Hugging Face Hub scanning.
svg.text: AI Model Supply Chain & Deserialization Safety
PyTorch pickle RCE vectors vs Safetensors zero-code deserialization, ModelScan CLI automation, and weights_only enforcement.
• Mechanism: Executable Python opcodes evaluated during torch.load()
• Exploitation: os.system() / subprocess payload execution on host
• Mitigation: Enforce torch.load(..., weights_only=True) or convert to Safetensors
• Structure: JSON header metadata + raw byte tensor buffer
• Safety: Eliminates pickle RCE completely (no code execution)
• Performance: Zero-copy memory mapping for fast model loading
Static Model File Inspection & Hub Scanning
• ModelScan CLI: Scans PyTorch, Pickle, Keras, TensorFlow, and XGBoost files for dangerous opcodes
• Hugging Face Security: Automated malware scanning, pickle inspection, and Safetensors conversion badges
• CI/CD Pipeline Rule: Reject un-scanned .pkl files and enforce mandatory Safetensors conversion prior to model deployment
MODEL SUPPLY CHAIN: DOWNLOAD MODEL → MODELSCAN CLI INSPECTION → CONVERT TO SAFETENSORS → TORCH.LOAD(WEIGHTS_ONLY=TRUE)
